# TEMPORARY self-check tally (see render_selfcheck in the generator).
# Scope: country.
covert_tech_selfcheck_research_tally = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_researching_technology = ICBMs }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = guided_missiles
				has_technology_researched = nuclear_weapons
			}
			covert_tech_selfcheck_held = { TECH = ICBMs }
		}
		else = {
			covert_tech_selfcheck_stranded = { TECH = ICBMs }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_researching_technology = abyssal_plain_mining }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = additive_manufacturing
				has_technology_researched = advanced_structural_engineering
			}
			covert_tech_selfcheck_held = { TECH = abyssal_plain_mining }
		}
		else = {
			covert_tech_selfcheck_stranded = { TECH = abyssal_plain_mining }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_researching_technology = additive_manufacturing }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = robotics
				has_technology_researched = supply_chain_management
			}
			covert_tech_selfcheck_held = { TECH = additive_manufacturing }
		}
		else = {
			covert_tech_selfcheck_stranded = { TECH = additive_manufacturing }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_researching_technology = admiralty }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = navigation
			}
			covert_tech_selfcheck_held = { TECH = admiralty }
		}
		else = {
			covert_tech_selfcheck_stranded = { TECH = admiralty }
		}
	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {
